title: All-in-one neuromorphic hardware with 2D material technology: current status and future perspective
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,8196-8242
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00251F, Review Article
Guobin Zhang, Qi Luo, Jiacheng Yao, Shuai Zhong, Hua Wang, Fei Xue, Bin Yu, Kian Ping Loh, Yishu Zhang
This review examines 2D materials for next-gen computing, covering sensing, memory, and neuromorphic devices. It highlights single-material systems, in-memory computing, near-sensor architectures, and challenges ahead.
